title: 第11章 仙人印第12章 桃园对峙
slug: 北侯世子反派的我背景逆天
lines: 掌风瞬间而至，而裴苏依旧不紧不慢垂下双手，眉心忽然亮起一道仙光，顿时刺破天边神霞。
虽是玄元之境，那般极高层级的威压却是令身为天宫的萧粦都有种忍不住顶礼膜拜的冲动。
裴苏眉间仙人印，乃是上古以来人间最为神秘顶尖的法相天赋。
传闻涉及到有关上古人族起源的某个名为【仙印神瞳】的神话传说。
即便放眼人族历史，身负仙印者也寥寥无几，但每一位无不是成就人间绝巅，在青史上都留下浓墨的一笔。
仙人印的上一次出现还要追溯到六千年前，那位终结春秋乱世，一统神州，半步入仙，聚天下王气于一身的始皇帝身上。
裴苏浑身仙霞缭绕，天光灼灼，隐隐有灼热的气息升腾而起，而天宫掌力亦是不同凡响，似乎还携着庚金之芒，压得空间锋锐如割。
轰！
巨大的轰鸣响彻天地。
萧粦不敢逗留，携着赵岚已经飞上云巅。
下一刻，极速掠行的他眼睛一瞪，嘴角突兀溢出一口鲜血，狠声低喃：
“九玄神鎏甲！”
他狂压下那神甲的反噬，冲天而去，心头又是震撼又是苦涩。
刚刚那一掌之下，他回头瞧上了一眼，裴苏身上居然穿有一神甲法宝，他的天宫掌力，竟全然被裴苏身上神鎏甲反噬给了自己。
而裴苏不过退后数步，别说重创，连伤势都轻微不计。
最令萧粦感到恐惧的，还是那一刻他所显露的仙印神通。
不过玄元之境，却是施展出极其恐怖的仙术，也未免太过震世骇俗。
他曾为皇宫禁军副统，曾经也见过不少帝京的年轻才俊，甚至其中不乏将军之子，王侯之后，放眼大晋都是顶尖的天骄。
但他们之中，无论施展多逆天术法，无一人能比拟刚刚刹那的天光仙霞之威。
萧粦忽的想起，他隐藏的二十载间，曾无数次听闻散修游侠吹嘘，北侯世子裴九牧有多么多么妖孽，他眉心仙人印有多么多么无双。
尽管极少有人见识过北侯世子真正出手，但从未有人怀疑过裴苏的天赋实力。
一切，皆是因为他天生一道仙人印。
他以前未曾放在心上，此刻，心头却有了深刻的度量。
只是慨叹的下一刻，心头惧意喷涌。
这等千年不遇的妖孽，偏偏又生在了原本就鼎盛无比，权势滔天的裴家，这让天下门阀宗门，如何自处，如何看开啊！
而且，裴家中人...
萧粦深深切齿。
人均枭雄毒心！
裴苏远望萧粦离去的方位，压制着体内翻腾的气血。
天宫一掌，即便是重伤之下仓促使出，也本不是玄元境能接下的。
“总算也是体会了一番天宫掌力，就是不知，是其巅峰的几成威力……”
裴苏心中大致称量了一下，随即眺望了远处，感知到了武老的气息。
十几息后，一个黑袍老者以狂速之态掠至此地，止住身形之力让大地都微微龟裂，尘土飞扬。
他径直跪下，深深俯首——
“少主，萧粦被老奴暗中种下毒印，是老奴刻意放逃，却不料让萧粦伤及少主！老奴罪极！罪该万死！”
裴苏心头暗笑一声，他接萧粦一掌，除了想试试自己的仙印神通，顺便体会一下天宫之威外，还有便是吓吓这老东西。
而见裴苏气息紊乱，似乎被萧粦伤到，黑袍老者身躯都微微颤抖起来，其眼中泄出浓浓杀意。

The wind from the palm came in an instant, but Pei Su still lowered his hands slowly, and a fairy light suddenly lit up between his eyebrows, which immediately pierced the sky.
Although he was in the realm of Xuanyuan, the extremely high level of pressure made Xiao Lin, who was in the Heavenly Palace, have the urge to worship him.
The Immortal Seal between Pei Su's eyebrows is the most mysterious and top-notch Dharma talent in the world since ancient times.
The rumors involve a certain myth and legend called [Immortal Seal Divine Eye] about the origin of the ancient human race.
Even if we look at the history of the human race, there are only a few people who bear the Immortal Seal, but every one of them has achieved the highest level in the world and left a strong mark in the history of the world.
The last time the Immortal Seal appeared was six thousand years ago, on the First Emperor who ended the chaos of the Spring and Autumn Period, unified China, became a semi-immortal, and gathered the aura of a king in the world.
Pei Su's whole body was surrounded by fairy clouds, the sky was scorching, and a faint scorching breath was rising. The power of the Tiangong palm was also extraordinary, and it seemed to carry the light of Geng gold, making the space as sharp as cutting.
boom!
A huge roar resounded throughout the world.
Xiao Lin didn't dare to stay and had already flown to the top of the clouds with Zhao Lan.
The next moment, his eyes widened as he was flying at high speed, a mouthful of blood suddenly spilled from the corner of his mouth, and he murmured fiercely:
"Nine Mysterious Gods Gilded Armor!"
He violently suppressed the backlash of the divine armor and soared into the sky, feeling shocked and bitter at the same time.
Under the palm just now, he looked back and saw that Pei Su was actually wearing a divine armor magic weapon. His palm power was completely absorbed by Pei Su's divine gilded armor and was given to him.
But Pei Su only took a few steps back. Not to mention serious injuries, even the injuries were minor.
What frightened Xiao Li the most was the magical power of the Immortal Seal he revealed at that moment.
However, in the realm of Xuanyuan, he can perform extremely terrifying magic, which is too shocking to the world.
He was once the deputy commander of the imperial army. He had met many young talents in the imperial capital, including many sons of generals. After princes and princes, they were all top talents in the Jin Dynasty.
But among them, no matter how many heaven-defying spells they cast, no one could compare to the power of the heavenly light and fairy clouds just now.
Xiao Lin suddenly remembered that during the twenty years he had been hiding, he had heard the Rogue Cultivators bragging countless times about how evil the Beihou Crown Prince Pei Jiumu was and how unparalleled the Immortal Seal between his eyebrows was.
Although few people have seen the Northern Marquis Prince actually take action, no one has ever doubted Pei Su's talent.
All because he was born with an Immortal Seal.
He had never taken it to heart before, but now, he felt a deep sense of it.
Just the next moment after sighing, fear surged in my heart.
Such a monster, which has not been seen in thousands of years, happened to be born in the Pei family, which was already extremely prosperous and powerful. This made all the sects in the world how to deal with it and how to deal with it!
Moreover, the Pei family...
Xiao Lin gritted his teeth deeply.
The per capita tycoon has a vicious heart!
······
Pei Su looked far away at the direction where Xiao Lin left, suppressing the surging energy and blood in his body.
A palm from Tiangong, even if it was rushed out under serious injury, was not something that the Xuanyuan realm could handle.
"Finally, I have experienced the power of Tiangong Palm, but I don't know how much of its peak power it is..."
Pei Su roughly weighed it in his mind, then looked into the distance and sensed Elder Wu's aura.
More than ten breaths later, an old man in black robes rushed to this place at a furious speed, stopping his body with such force that the earth cracked slightly and dust flew up.
He knelt down and bowed his head deeply——
"Young Master, Xiao Min was secretly planted with a poison mark by the old slave. The old slave deliberately escaped, but unexpectedly allowed Xiao Min to hurt the young master! The old slave is guilty of the worst crime! He deserves death!"
Pei Su secretly chuckled in his heart. He took Xiao Lin's palm. In addition to trying his immortal seal magical power and experiencing the power of the Celestial Palace, he also wanted to scare this old guy.
Seeing that Pei Su's aura was disordered and he seemed to have been injured by Xiao Lin, the black-robed old man's body began to tremble slightly, and his eyes revealed strong murderous intent.
